senses.gloss: m. (קִשְׁקֵשׁ I) hoeing the ground (around olive trees).
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 3a:17">M. Kat. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מנין לעידור וק׳ וכ׳</he> whence is it learned that hoeing of vines, and hoeing of olive trees, and clearing are forbidden in the Sabbatical year? <cite ref="Moed Katan 3a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>וק׳ … שרי</he> is hoeing in the Sabbatical year permitted?; <cite ref="Sukkah 44b:7">Succ. 44ᵇ</cite> Ms. M.
